title: Cat Believes He Can Meet A Forever Family Once His Legs Are Fixed (Part 2) | Kritter Klub
description:
*Please don't forget to hit the CC button for Subtitles*

Cat Gina awaits a miracle, which is meeting a forever family whom he can share the love with for his whole life.. First up, he practices walking with an assistant device, his foster mom gave him. Will he be able to walk without getting hurt?
